A 回到同一 k，但平方不是 −I；此反幺正操作本身不保证 Kramers 配对: A returns to the same k, but its square is not −I. This antiunitary operation alone does not guarantee Kramers pairing.
A 把态送到另一个 k 空间；即使平方为 −I，也不能据此保证同一 k 的 Kr: A sends the state to another k space. Even a square of −I does not then guarantee Kramers degeneracy at the same k.
A=T_(c/2)Θ 从 H_k 到 H_−k；B_A(k)=S(−k)⊗J。第: A=T_(c/2)Theta maps H_k to H_−k, with B_A(k)=S(−k)⊗J. The second action must use B_A(−k) and conjugate all coefficients from the first action.
G 保持 k；它是幺正操作，平方为 −I 本身不能推出 Kramers 简并。: G preserves k and is unitary. Its square of −I alone does not imply Kramers degeneracy.
Z 点反幺正反例对称且无简并: The Z-point antiunitary counterexample preserves the symmetry and has no degeneracy
Z 点：反幺正平方为 +I 也可没有简并: Z point: an antiunitary square of +I can coexist with no degeneracy
k 不是有效有理数。: k is not a valid rational number.
k 仅接受有限十进制或简单有理数，不执行函数或表达式。: k accepts only finite decimals or simple rational numbers; functions and expressions are not executed.
k 仅接受有限整数、十进制或 p/q，不接受符号表达式。: k accepts only finite integers, decimals, or p/q, without symbolic expressions.
k 必须包含三个倒格矢分数。: k must contain three reciprocal-lattice fractions.
k 的每个分量必须有限。: Every component of k must be finite.
k 超出精确教学范围：绝对值不超过 8，分母不超过 1000000。: k exceeds the exact teaching range: absolute value at most 8 and denominator at most 1000000.
spinful 必须为 true 或 false。: spinful must be true or false.
statePreset 必须为 basis 或 complex。: statePreset must be basis or complex.
Γ 点幺正反例对称且无简并: The Gamma-point unitary counterexample preserves the symmetry and has no degeneracy
Γ 点：幺正平方为 −I 仍可没有简并: Gamma point: a unitary square of −I need not produce degeneracy
① 保留跨胞位移，建立半平移矩阵: 1. Retain the intercell displacement and construct the half-translation matrix
② 第二次作用属于返回的波矢空间: 2. The second action belongs to the returning wavevector space

三个分量均满足 2k∈整数，才有 −k+G=k。此周期轨道规范下 G 为整数时基: The equation −k+G=k requires all three components of 2k to be integers. In this periodic orbital gauge, integer G gives the identity as the basis identification matrix.
三维格中的交错磁矩与半平移: Alternating moments and a half translation in a three-dimensional lattice
两次作用等于平方相位乘初态: Two actions equal the square phase times the initial state
两次半平移留下整胞相位: Two half translations leave the full-cell phase
先区分幺正与反幺正，再检查同一 k、平方及 Hamiltonian 对称性；有限: Distinguish unitary from antiunitary action, then check the same k, the square, and Hamiltonian symmetry. Matching arrows in a finite pattern cannot replace these conditions.
先跟踪 A 到 B、B 到下一原胞的 A，再把整胞 Bloch 相位放入对应矩阵: Track A to B and B to A in the next cell, then place the full-cell Bloch phase in the corresponding matrix column.
半平移与幺正自旋二重旋转 G: Half translation and unitary spin twofold rotation G
半平移与时间反演 A: Half translation and time reversal A
半平移沿 +z。第二个站点跨入下一原胞，因此矩阵第 A 行、第 B 列带整胞相位: The half translation is along +z. The second site enters the next cell, so row A, column B carries the full-cell phase. Folding the position back must not discard this phase.
半平移矩阵保持范数: The half-translation matrix preserves the norm
单位整胞平移在 k 的相位不受整数倒格矢平移影响；原胞内位置未放入指数的周期轨道: An integer reciprocal shift leaves the phase of a full-cell translation unchanged. The periodic orbital gauge excludes intracell positions from the exponential and makes the identification of −k+G explicit.
原一维实验只接收纵向数值 k，范围 −1 到 1、步长 0.05；复制后仍需手动: The original one-dimensional experiment accepts a numerical longitudinal k from −1 to 1 in steps of 0.05. Run it manually after copying.
反平移工坊含未知输入字段。: The antitranslation workshop contains an unknown input field.
反平移工坊输入必须为 JSON 对象。: Antitranslation workshop input must be a JSON object.
反幺正矩阵部分保持范数: The matrix part of the antiunitary action preserves the norm
同一 k 且平方为 −I 时所选态与其像正交: At the same k with square −I, the selected state is orthogonal to its image
同一 k 判据逐个分量成立: The same-k criterion is checked component by component
同一 k 条件与 A²=−I 同时满足；还须由 Hamiltonian 的 A: The same-k condition and A²=−I both hold. Pairing additionally requires A symmetry of the Hamiltonian.
周期轨道 Bloch 基取 Σ_R exp(+2πik·R)|R,α,s〉；T_: The periodic orbital Bloch basis is sum_R exp(+2πik·R)|R,alpha,s>, and T_n has eigenvalue exp(−2πik·n). The three magnetic-cell edges have length 1; A and B are at z=0 and 1/2.
固定 Z 点的有限矩阵反例；A²=+I 不禁止其他对称性或偶然简并。: A finite-matrix counterexample at fixed Z. A²=+I does not rule out degeneracies from other symmetries or accidental equalities.
固定 Γ 点的有限矩阵反例，不是对交错磁序材料 Hamiltonian 的拟合。: A finite-matrix counterexample at fixed Gamma, rather than a fitted Hamiltonian for a material with alternating moments.
在一般 k，A 连接两个不同波矢空间；将 B_A(k) 当作同一空间矩阵直接平方: At generic k, A connects two different wavevector spaces. Directly squaring or reusing B_A(k) as a same-space matrix loses the returning space and complex conjugation.
存在横向 k 分量；不能静默丢弃它们后复制到一维实验。: Transverse k components are present. They cannot be silently discarded when copying to the one-dimensional experiment.
平方相位只含 k_z，但 A 反转三个动量分量。横向一般动量仍会去往另一个空间。: The square phase depends only on k_z, but A reverses all three momentum components. Generic transverse momentum still goes to another space.
幺正对照具有相同平方相位但不同定理条件: The unitary comparison has the same square phase but different theorem conditions
所选初态已规范化: The selected initial state is normalized
文献也可选负向半平移或嵌入位置的 Bloch 规范，矩阵和相位写法随之改变；比较: Literature may choose a negative half translation or a position-embedded Bloch gauge, changing the matrix and phase expressions. Align the translation direction, k units, and basis before comparison.
本工坊只计算给定两子格表示及其精确操作。没有从原子结构搜索磁空间群，也没有计算材: This workshop computes the supplied two-sublattice representation and its exact actions. It does not search a structure's magnetic space group or calculate material bands or topological invariants.
此对照指定自旋 1/2 的幺正二重旋转；无自旋分支不把它当作已有算符。: This comparison specifies the unitary twofold rotation for spin 1/2. It is not treated as an existing operator in the spinless branch.
此精确 k 不在原一维表单的合法步长或范围内；可继续查看本工坊精确结果。: This exact k is outside the original one-dimensional form's permitted step grid or range. The exact workshop result remains available.
第一次先共轭初态，再由 B_A(k) 送到 −k；第二次共轭整条中间态，再乘 B: First conjugate the initial state and apply B_A(k) to reach −k. Then conjugate the whole intermediate state and multiply by B_A(−k).
箭头只检验给定图案；不显示复振幅或 Bloch 相位。无自旋分支的箭头表示抽象时: Arrows test only the supplied pattern and do not show complex amplitudes or Bloch phases. In the spinless branch they represent an abstract time-odd order parameter.
自旋 1/2 的 J=−iσ_y 且 Θ²=−1；无自旋分支 J=1、Θ²=+1: For spin 1/2, J=−iσ_y and Theta²=−1. The spinless branch uses J=1 and Theta²=+1; its alternating arrows represent an abstract time-odd order parameter.
跨两个波矢空间的正确平方: The correct square through two wavevector spaces
这个固定点四维 Hamiltonian 与 G 对易，四个能级各不相同；它没有: This four-dimensional Hamiltonian at a fixed point commutes with G and has four distinct energies. It does not have A symmetry.
